title: Country Road Marketplace - Christmas Show
seo_title: Country Road Marketplace Christmas Show in Bolivar, MO
description: This is a holiday shopping day with 50+ local crafters, artists, and small businesses selling handmade gifts, festive decor, candles, jewelry, treats and more, with Christmas music playing throughout. Admission is free, and the show was formerly known as Boot Country Craft Show. It takes place December 12, 2026 (Time TBD) at the Elks Lodge, 1990 W Broadway St in Bolivar, MO.
address: Elks Lodge, 1990 W Broadway St, Bolivar, MO 65613, United States, Bolivar, MO
